title: vhlink:/ text form
description: Restates IHE VHL ITI-YY3, 2:3.YY3.4.1.3 Expected Actions; RFC 4648. IHE VHL ITI-YY3 Generate VHL, 2:3.YY3.4.1.3 Expected Actions: “Prefixed with vhlink:/”.

statements.label: vhlink:/ text form
statements.requirement: The library SHALL convert a VHL payload to and from its text form: the minified JSON, base64url-encoded without padding (RFC 4648), prefixed with vhlink:/.
